setting.defaultres.name: Resolution Width
setting.defaultres.description: Horizontal pixel count of the game's render resolution. Combined with resolution height it defines the rendered picture; it should normally match your monitor's native resolution.
setting.defaultres.recommended: Match your monitor's native resolution, e.g. 1920

setting.defaultresheight.name: Resolution Height
setting.defaultresheight.description: Vertical pixel count of the game's render resolution, used together with resolution width. Lowering it improves FPS but the image gets blurrier.
setting.defaultresheight.recommended: Match your monitor's native resolution, e.g. 1080

setting.fullscreen.name: Fullscreen Mode
setting.fullscreen.description: Controls the display mode: 1 is exclusive fullscreen, 0 is windowed (borderless depends on setting.nowindowborder). Exclusive fullscreen usually gives lower input lag and steadier performance.

setting.nowindowborder.name: Borderless Window
setting.nowindowborder.description: When 1, the game runs as a borderless window: faster alt-tabbing, at the cost of possibly slightly higher input lag. 0 pairs with fullscreen mode.

setting.mat_vsync_mode.name: V-Sync Mode
setting.mat_vsync_mode.description: Controls how the picture is synchronized with the monitor's refresh signal. Disabling V-Sync lowers input lag but may cause screen tearing.

setting.mat_backbuffer_count.name: Swap Chain Buffers
setting.mat_backbuffer_count.description: Number of render back buffers; affects frame queuing depth and input lag. Changing it may cause compatibility or stability issues, so test carefully.
setting.mat_backbuffer_count.recommended: Keep the default unless you know why you are changing it

setting.mat_antialias_mode.name: Anti-Aliasing Mode
setting.mat_antialias_mode.description: Anti-aliasing scheme that smooths model edges; 0 disables it. Higher settings look smoother but cost more rendering time.

setting.dvs_enable.name: Dynamic V-Sync
setting.dvs_enable.description: Automatically switches between V-Sync on and off based on GPU frame time, balancing tearing against input lag.

setting.dvs_gpuframetime_min.name: Dynamic V-Sync Min Frame Time
setting.dvs_gpuframetime_min.description: Target minimum GPU time per frame in microseconds. Together with the max frame time it defines the dynamic V-Sync window. Irrelevant when dynamic V-Sync is off.

setting.dvs_gpuframetime_max.name: Dynamic V-Sync Max Frame Time
setting.dvs_gpuframetime_max.description: Maximum allowed GPU time per frame in microseconds. When exceeded, dynamic V-Sync stops waiting for the vertical blank to keep FPS up.

setting.dvs_supersample_enable.name: Dynamic V-Sync Supersampling
setting.dvs_supersample_enable.description: Allows dynamic V-Sync to render at higher resolution when frame time allows. Better image quality, but more FPS variance.

setting.gamma.name: Gamma (Brightness)
setting.gamma.description: Overall picture brightness. Higher values make dark areas easier to see, but wash out contrast and make the image look flat.

setting.csm_enabled.name: Cascaded Shadow Maps
setting.csm_enabled.description: Master switch for dynamic shadow rendering. Turning it off gives a large FPS boost, but character and object shadows disappear, removing shadow-based positional information.
setting.csm_enabled.recommended: 0 for FPS, 1 if you rely on shadow cues

setting.csm_coverage.name: Shadow Coverage
setting.csm_coverage.description: Scene coverage range of cascaded shadows. Smaller values cover a shorter distance with lower cost.

setting.csm_cascade_res.name: Shadow Cascade Resolution
setting.csm_cascade_res.description: Resolution of the cascaded shadow maps. Lower values give coarser shadows at lower cost.

setting.shadow_enable.name: Shadow Rendering
setting.shadow_enable.description: Master switch for scene shadows. Turning it off removes most shadows and notably improves FPS, at the cost of shadow-based information.
setting.shadow_enable.recommended: 0 for FPS, 1 if you rely on shadow cues

setting.shadow_depth_dimen_min.name: Shadow Map Minimum Size
setting.shadow_depth_dimen_min.description: Minimum allowed size of shadow depth maps. Lowering it saves VRAM but reduces shadow quality.

setting.shadow_depth_upres_factor_max.name: Shadow Upres Factor Max
setting.shadow_depth_upres_factor_max.description: Maximum upscaling factor for shadow maps. Lowering it saves performance but makes shadows blurrier.

setting.shadow_maxdynamic.name: Max Dynamic Shadows
setting.shadow_maxdynamic.description: Cap on simultaneously rendered dynamic light shadows. Setting it to 0 disables dynamic shadow rendering.

setting.new_shadow_settings.name: New Shadow Settings Toggle
setting.new_shadow_settings.description: Whether the new shadow parameter set is active. It changes how several other shadow entries in this file behave.
setting.new_shadow_settings.recommended: Keep the current value; do not change it

setting.ssao_enabled.name: Ambient Occlusion (SSAO)
setting.ssao_enabled.description: Screen-space ambient occlusion, producing contact shadows where objects meet. Turning it off improves FPS; depth perception is slightly reduced.

setting.ssao_downsample.name: SSAO Downsample
setting.ssao_downsample.description: Downsampling factor for ambient occlusion. Higher values cost less but produce coarser occlusion.

setting.volumetric_lighting.name: Volumetric Lighting
setting.volumetric_lighting.description: Light scattering through air (light shafts and similar). Turning it off improves FPS; scene atmosphere is slightly reduced.

setting.volumetric_fog.name: Volumetric Fog
setting.volumetric_fog.description: Volumetric fog effects in the scene. Turning it off improves FPS; distant visibility changes slightly in some maps.

setting.mat_forceaniso.name: Anisotropic Filtering
setting.mat_forceaniso.description: Keeps textures sharp at oblique viewing angles. The FPS cost is small.

setting.mat_mip_linear.name: Linear Texture Filtering
setting.mat_mip_linear.description: Controls whether linear mip filtering is used. Turning it off makes distant textures sharper but noticeably shimmery and noisy.

setting.mat_picmip.name: Texture Detail
setting.mat_picmip.description: Texture mip bias: 0 is the highest detail, 4 the lowest. Lower detail improves FPS and saves VRAM at the cost of blurrier textures; works together with setting.stream_memory.
setting.mat_picmip.recommended: 4 on low-end systems, 0 to 1 for image quality

setting.stream_memory.name: Texture Streaming Memory
setting.stream_memory.description: Memory budget for texture streaming. Too low a value leaves textures blurry for long stretches; 0 combined with mat_picmip 4 forces the lowest texture detail.

setting.particle_cpu_level.name: Particle Effect Level
setting.particle_cpu_level.description: Quality level of CPU-side particle effects. Lowering it reduces performance dips during fights.

setting.cl_gib_allow.name: Gib Effects
setting.cl_gib_allow.description: Allows flying debris when characters or objects are destroyed. Turning it off reduces the effect load with little visible change in combat.

setting.cl_particle_fallback_base.name: Particle Fallback Base
setting.cl_particle_fallback_base.description: Base tier for falling back to simpler particle effects under load. Higher values fall back more aggressively.

setting.cl_particle_fallback_multiplier.name: Particle Fallback Multiplier
setting.cl_particle_fallback_multiplier.description: Multiplier for particle degradation under load. Higher values switch to cheaper effects more readily.

setting.cl_ragdoll_maxcount.name: Ragdoll Count Cap
setting.cl_ragdoll_maxcount.description: Maximum number of simultaneous ragdolls (death physics). Setting it to 0 disables ragdolls and reduces physics cost in fights.

setting.cl_ragdoll_self_collision.name: Ragdoll Self Collision
setting.cl_ragdoll_self_collision.description: Collision between ragdoll body parts. Turning it off saves a little performance; poses look slightly less natural.

setting.r_createmodeldecals.name: Model Decals
setting.r_createmodeldecals.description: Generates bullet holes and similar decals on model surfaces. Turning it off improves FPS stability during firefights.

setting.r_decals.name: Decal Count
setting.r_decals.description: Number of decals (bullet holes, marks) kept in the scene at once. Lower values cost less.

setting.r_lod_switch_scale.name: LOD Switch Distance
setting.r_lod_switch_scale.description: Scale for model level-of-detail (LOD) switch distances. Lower values swap distant models to lower detail earlier: better FPS, coarser distant geometry.
setting.r_lod_switch_scale.recommended: 0.4 to 0.6 on low-end systems, 1.0 for image quality

setting.fadedistscale.name: Fade Distance Scale
setting.fadedistscale.description: Scales the distance at which objects fade out. Lower values drop distant scenery earlier, reducing render load but making pop-in easier to notice.
setting.fadedistscale.recommended: Keep the default; lower slightly on weak hardware

setting.configversion.name: Config File Version
setting.configversion.description: Version marker of the videoconfig.txt structure, used by the game to identify the file format and field meanings.
setting.configversion.recommended: Keep the original value; do not edit
